notes: atSec is BODY-RELATIVE seconds -- the same clock cuts[].start uses. keybridge declares
leadSeconds 0, so these are also absolute inside <Sequence name="Body">.
ORDERING CONSTRAINT: ae013 (presumption of innocence, script :267) MUST precede ae010
(the charges, script :271). That is the script's own order and the legally careful one.
If a timing tweak ever moves either card, this ordering is what has to survive.
keybridge_ae003 (26 MARCH 2024) is deliberately UNPLACED: the string '26 March' does not
occur in the script and every date sentence in the narration is the twenty-fifth, so
placing it would put two dates in the eye and the ear inside one second. See section 2 of
the placement doc for the three ways out; option (a), hold it, is what this file does.
